summaryZh: Hibbs 实验室研究神经系统快速通信的精细机制、疾病中的异常以及药物的调节作用。项目涉及生物物理、结构生物学、神经药理学、神经系统自身免疫病及神经递质受体演化；页面未明确具体实验方法。
researchQuestions: 神经系统中的快速信号传递在疾病中如何失常？
药物如何改变这种信号传递？

evidence.quote: We are investigating the fine details of fast communication in the nervous system, how this signaling goes awry in disease, and how drugs alter it. Ongoing projects span basic biophysics and structural biology to neuropharmacology, mechanisms underlying autoimmune diseases of the nervous system, and the evolution of neurotransmitter receptors.
